subject: POC evaluation playbook + blockers log (Acme AI)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa.gomez@acmeai.com>, Mark Liu <mark.liu@acmeai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: Post-call recap + proposed POC playbook (next steps)

Hi Alyssa / Mark —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the playbook I'm proposing so we can get the trial running next week:

1) Goal / success criteria (what Acme needs to be comfortable):
- End-to-end integration of Redwood inference into Acme's staging environment (private VPC).
- Latency at 95th percentile <= 200ms for 512-token responses for our recommended model profile.
- Token cost estimate within 30% of Redwood baseline for your throughput (target: ~$0.003/token).
- No data exfiltration issues and SOC2 evidence items signed off by your security team.

2) Scope / deliverables (what Redwood will deliver):
- POC environment: Dedicated small pool in us-west with private control plane.
- Integration support: SDK + mounting examples, sample inference harness, and a redwood-ops-runbook.md.
- Measurement: 3-day steady-state run with perf tracing and cost report.

3) Timeline (proposed):
- Tue 2026-07-20: Kickoff + access exchange (VPN certs / service account).
- Wed–Fri 2026-07-21 to 2026-07-23: Integration & smoke tests.
- Mon 2026-07-26 to Wed 2026-07-28: Steady-state run and measurements.
- Thu 2026-07-29: Demo + findings + recommended config.

4) Owners / contacts:
- Acme: Alyssa (PM) — overall signoff; Mark (CTO) — architecture/security; Daniel (SecOps) — SOC2 evidence.
- Redwood: Rishi (AM) — timeline + coordination; Marissa (Solutions) — integration help; Aditya (SRE) — runtime tune & ops.

5) Known risks and proposed mitigations (first-pass):
- Risk A: Private VPC peering delays (network ACLs). Mitigation: Temporary SSH-based tunnelling and allowlist; Owner: Marissa; Escalation: Aditya.
- Risk B: Tokenization mismatch causing output drift. Mitigation: Introduce token-hashing test harness to compare outputs; Owner: Solutions (Marissa).
- Risk C: SOC2 docs missing a couple control artifacts. Mitigation: Redwood to provide SOC2-Extract-2025.pdf and a short mapping doc; Owner: Rishi; Escalation: Legal if e-signature required.

6) Attachments included: AcmeAI-POC-scope.xlsx (detailed checklist), SOC2-Extract-2025.pdf (evidence extract).

Next steps for you: please confirm the kickoff time Tue 7/20 and add Daniel to the kickoff if possible. I’ll upload the POC scope to the shared Drive and raise the HubSpot deal.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123


----
From: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa.gomez@acmeai.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Liu <mark.liu@acmeai.com>, Daniel Park <d.park@acmeai.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Post-call recap + proposed POC playbook (next steps)

Thanks Rishi — this looks great and aligned with what we discussed. A couple quick notes: 

- Kickoff: Tue 7/20 10:00am PT works for us. I’ve added Daniel (SecOps) here.
- Success criteria: Can we add a qualitative item — model responses must not hallucinate factual customer identifiers in 95% of prompts in our 200-sample prompt set. That’s critical for our compliance review.
- Security: Daniel will need the SOC2 extract and a list of AWS IAM roles used by Redwood for the private deployment.

We’ll sign the SOW after the demo if perf and security checks look good.

Best,
Alyssa
Product Lead, Integrations — Acme AI
alyssa.gomez@acmeai.com


----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Post-call recap + proposed POC playbook (next steps)

Looping internal owners — I’ll take the integration tasks. Quick notes after reviewing the scope: 

- Network: If Acme requires strict ACLs we should prepare a temporary VPN tunnel option (I have a cookbook). I’ll include steps in redwood-ops-runbook.md.
- Tokenization: We should run a token-compatibility check before the steady-state run — I’ll prep a small script.
- Perf: Aditya, we may want to pre-warm the KV cache and pin model shards for the 7/26 steady-state run; can you confirm availability of a devoted slot (small dedicated pool) that week?

Potential blocker: there is an internal issue in our autotuner that can inflate latency slightly in certain sequence-length mixes (ticket RK-1189). If that shows up during smoke tests it could push the 95p above target. Suggested mitigation: bypass autotuner for the POC and use a conservative kernel selection. Aditya — can you assess effort to enable bypass mode for a single customer slot?

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai


----
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Post-call recap + proposed POC playbook (next steps)

Thanks — short update from infra/SRE: 

- RK-1189 (autotuner regression): I can enable a bypass mode for the dedicated slot; low-risk change but requires a config flip and a quick validation run. ETA: 1 business day. Owner: Aditya.
- Dedicated slot: I can reserve a small pool 7/25–7/29 (2xA10G-equivalent). Need final confirmation on expected concurrent QPS and typical sequence-length distribution from Acme (Alyssa/Mark).
- IAM list & SOC2 artifacts: Rishi, I’ll compile a minimal IAM roles doc for Daniel and attach the SOC2 extract to the Drive folder.

If RK-1189 surfaces during the smoke tests we’ll escalate to platform reliability and keep Acme updated.

—
Aditya Rao
Principal SRE | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai


----
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa.gomez@acmeai.com>, Mark Liu <mark.liu@acmeai.com>, Daniel Park <d.park@acmeai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-21T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Post-call recap + proposed POC playbook (next steps) — confirmed kickoff + owner map

All — thanks for the quick responses and alignment. Final confirmations: 

- Kickoff Tue 7/20 10:00am PT (calendar invite sent).
- Owners: Marissa (integration lead), Aditya (infrastructure SRE, RK-1189 bypass + dedicated slot), Rishi (commercial & security / SOC2 coordination).
- Added success criterion per Alyssa: qualitative hallucination check (95% pass on Acme 200-sample set) — Marissa will coordinate test harness.
- We will use the bypass for autotuner during the POC window to reduce latency risk; Aditya to enable and validate by 7/25.

Action items: 
- Rishi: upload AcmeAI-POC-scope.xlsx to Drive, raise HubSpot deal, share DocuSign SOW link. (DONE: Drive link in related_links).
- Marissa: token-compatibility script & test harness (ETA: 7/21 EOD).
- Aditya: reserve dedicated slot & enable RK-1189 bypass (ETA: 7/25).
- Alyssa / Acme: confirm expected QPS & sequence-length distribution by 7/21 so we can size the slot.

Risks to watch: network peering delays, RK-1189 surfacing, SOC2 artifacts lagging. If anything blocks the steady-state run we will escalate to the platform reliability lead and propose a short extension rather than a rushed test.

Looking forward to the kickoff tomorrow.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: AcmeAI-POC-scope.xlsx, SOC2-Extract-2025.pdf
